itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line1: Long ago, the Berry God said to the villagers:
itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line2: 'A cunning and greedy player will come to this world. They will do evil to you.'
itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line3: The villagers were astonished and bowed down at his words. Some worshipped berries, while others advanced bioscience.
itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line4: Fearing bioscience, the god quickly banished the scientists.
itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line5: After that, the scientists continued to camp and conduct research, creating a weapon against players called the Sugardian.
itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line6: But scientists with weak survival skills could not survive alone, and their bloodline died out.
itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line7: Although their faith in God was still insufficient, they did not rule by fear.
itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line8: Was it a small act of kindness, or simply a whim? Only God knows.
itemTooltip.sugar.selfish_lore.line9: Many years passed, and now Berry's power has weakened, and the villagers have forgotten the player's existence.
itemTooltip.sugar.dragon_lore.line1: In the Overworld, there was a dragon and a group of dragonkin surrounding it.
itemTooltip.sugar.dragon_lore.line2: The dragon foretold the player's presence and fled with its people to the End.
itemTooltip.sugar.dragon_lore.line3: Influenced by the End, they transformed into Ender Dragon and Ender Man.
itemTooltip.sugar.dragon_lore.line4: Some of the dragonkin who remained in the Overworld eventually transformed into Hermit Dragon.
itemTooltip.sugar.red_lore.line1: Once the 'Twin AMD' is completed, this war will end and peace will prevail.
itemTooltip.sugar.red_lore.line2: To hell with old-fashioned magic! The age of industrialization and communism is here!
itemTooltip.sugar.blue_lore.line1: Their weapon, the 'Twin AMD', is too powerful; the Arc tribe will surely be annihilated.
itemTooltip.sugar.blue_lore.line2: I entrusted the Arc's eggs to the gnomes; even they won't be able to detect them.
itemTooltip.sugar.blue_lore.line3: God, please quell that abominable red army!
